name: Venser
description: Venser was a brilliant inventor and planeswalker, a friend of Karn, who gave up his spark and his life to save Karn.

description_citations.text: "Venser". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"New Phyrexia". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Venser was a brilliant inventor and planeswalker, a friend of Karn, who gave up his spark and his life to save Karn.

citations.text: "Venser". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"New Phyrexia". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Venser's talent ignited his spark, making him a planeswalker with access to the planes beyond Dominaria.

citations.text: "Venser". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: On New Phyrexia, Koth, Elspeth and Venser could not turn the tide, and Venser sacrificed his life to restore Karn to sanity.

citations.text: "New Phyrexia". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Ajani later told Jhoira and others that Venser gave up his spark to save Karn and died.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

bio.text: Karn recalled being saved by Venser's sacrifice, and Elspeth spoke of him while fighting beside Jodah.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

citations.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

status.text: Venser is dead, having sacrificed his spark and life to save Karn, and he is remembered by his friends in later stories.

timeline.summary: Venser rescues Multani from the Yavimayan rift and Jeska seals it with Radha's spark, which burns out.
timeline.quote: Radha's spark burned out, causing the warlord to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jhoira and Venser go to an alternate Urborg timeline and help Venser planeswalk home.
timeline.quote: Teferi and Jhoira used their magic to help Venser complete his first planeswalk

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha and Venser accompany Jeska to the Otarian rift, where Jeska's final act closes all rifts.
timeline.quote: Jeska's final act closed the Otarian rift, as well as all others.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the Otarian rift closed by Jeska, the Great Mending begins.
timeline.quote: With the last major rift sealed, the Great Mending began.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Otarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser builds a sliver prototype intended to obey him.
timeline.quote: Venser admired his handiwork and smiled.

citation.text: Venser's Sliver (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jeska, Venser and Radha teleport into the heart of the Otarian rift.
timeline.quote: Jeska and the two planeswalkers teleported into the heart of the rift

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the temporal crisis a rift in Yavimaya suspends Multani; he imprisons Venser in a tree to ask for help.
timeline.quote: Multani imprisoned Venser in a tree in a similar manner as with Urza long ago, to ask for help.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas escapes the rift and is reborn using Venser's latent spark.
timeline.quote: he was able to finally escape his prison and be fully reborn into the physical world

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Time rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Jhoira help Venser complete his first planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Teferi and Jhoira used their magic to help Venser complete his first planeswalk

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Teferi's return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Urborg the group meets Venser and Teferi senses both he and Radha have planeswalker sparks different from his own.
timeline.quote: Teferi can discern that both Radha and Venser have the planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser's demonstration of the ambulator makes the rift react violently, and Teferi planeswalks into it; the whole group is pulled through the rift.
timeline.quote: the entire group is pulled into the rift falling through cracks in their reality

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Within the rift the group witnesses the events that caused Dominaria's rifts, including the Sylex and the obliteration of Tolaria.
timeline.quote: they witness the devastating events in Dominaria's history that caused the rifts plaguing the plane

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A disembodied voice tricks Venser and uses his and Radha's latent sparks to regain a body, revealing itself as Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: revealing itself to be Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser lives alone in a workshop in the Urborg swamps, salvaging Phyrexian remains and building his Ambulator while drawing Windgrace's ire.
timeline.quote: he lived alone in a workshop within the Urborg swamps, salvaging parts from the remains of Phyrexians left from the Invasion

citation.text: "Venser", section "Life in Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi finds Venser while researching the rift above Urborg.
timeline.quote: He had little success until the planeswalker Teferi found him while researching the rift above Urborg.

citation.text: "Venser", section "Life in Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser and Teferi's companions are swept through the rifts and deposited above Madara, where Radha faces the cat dragons.
timeline.quote: finally being deposited upon the cliffs overlooking the shores of Madara

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sensei Ryu takes hold of Venser's mind and uses his will and spark to re-enter the material world as Bolas.
timeline.quote: Ryu took hold of Venser's mind and used his will and spark to re-enter the material world in full dread glory

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi challenges Bolas to a duel and is demolished; Radha talks Bolas out of taking more than their guard Aprem's life, and Bolas departs with a threat to Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: with a dire threat against the inhabitants of Kamigawa , Bolas departed

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser travels with Jhoira to the Ghitu and perfects his throne device with Thran metal and powerstones.
timeline.quote: Venser managed to perfect his throne device, now constructed of Thran metal and ringed with newly created powerstones

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A flaw in the device sends Venser, Teferi and Jhoira to an alternate timeline, and Venser completes his first planeswalk home.
timeline.quote: Teferi and Jhoira use their magic to help Venser complete his first planeswalk back to the Dominaria they knew

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Windgrace catches Venser, who becomes one of his gladehunters.
timeline.quote: Venser agreed to become one of Windgrace's gladehunters, taking the planeswalker's mark upon his skin

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weaver King, impersonating Karn, infests Venser's mind in the Blind Eternities; Venser kills it using his planeswalking and powerstones.
timeline.quote: Venser was able to then kill the Weaver King through the cunning use of his planeswalking ability

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser helps Karn close the Tolarian rift and is the last person Karn speaks to before disappearing.
timeline.quote: Venser would be the last person Karn spoke to before his disappearance.

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska studies the rifts, uses Radha as her tool, and is stopped by Venser and company at great cost to Radha's spark and Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: only after grievous damage had been done to Radha's spark and Zhalfir

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska casts Venser and Radha back and sacrifices herself, and the Mending takes place.
timeline.quote: with that final sacrifice, the Mending took place

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser gives Jhoira the ambulator and planeswalks off to an unknown destination.
timeline.quote: giving Jhoira the ambulator as thanks for all they had done

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jhoira and Venser restore the wayward region of Shiv to its natural place in Dominaria, healing one rift.
timeline.quote: he has already succeeded in restoring the wayward region of Shiv to its natural place in Dominaria, healing one rift.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The trio attempts to teleport to Urborg and finds the chaos of an alternate Dominaria awaiting.
timeline.quote: But danger awaits them as the trio attempts to teleport to Urborg

citation.text: "Planar Chaos", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi has sealed the rift over Shiv, returning the continent, but is drained of all powers; Jhoira and Venser take him to the Ghitu, who help Venser build a new ambulator.
timeline.quote: However, the effort has drained the planeswalker of all his powers and left him incapacitated.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Venser go to Urborg to seek Lord Windgrace; Venser is captured by Windgrace and Jhoira meets Jodah, who explains the Weaver King.
timeline.quote: Venser is captured by Lord Windgrace while Jhoira encounters Jodah

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Windgrace consults Teferi, who deduces the Phyrexians come from an alternate reality; Windgrace takes the group to the Blind Eternities to meet Freyalise, and they decide to pursue the rifts independently.
timeline.quote: Windgrace and Freyalise decide to pursue each rift independently.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weaver King follows Jodah and Venser to Skyshroud and takes control of the slivers and Phyrexians; Freyalise channels all her mana into the rift, closing it and consuming herself.
timeline.quote: closing it but completely consuming herself in the process.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser tricks the Weaver King and kills him by rupturing powerstones.
timeline.quote: Venser utilizes his planeswalking abilities to trick the Weaver King and kill him

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn time travels to just before Barrin cast Obliterate and seals the Tolarian rift, but senses a dark corruption and flees across the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: proceeds to planeswalk randomly throughout the Blind Eternities to prevent anyone from following him.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska arrives in Urborg and asks where her mentor Karn is.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker protégé of Karn asks where her mentor is.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska questions Jhoira, Venser and Teferi, then goes to Otaria where Leshrac proposes using Venser's and Radha's sparks to close the rifts.
timeline.quote: Leshrac proposes that Jeska use Venser's and Radha ’s latent planeswalker sparks to channel mana and close them

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jhoira and Venser find Multani incapacitated by the Yavimaya rift.
timeline.quote: Venser can planeswalk into the rift and free Multani

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac reveals he had been influencing Jeska, paralyzes her and drains her black mana with the mask.
timeline.quote: Leshrac paralyzes her and uses the mask of the Myojin of Night’s Reach to drain Jeska’s black mana and corrosive touch from her time as Phage .

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska sacrifices herself to seal the last rift over Otaria, and the Mending alters the planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: Upon its sealing, the nature of the planeswalker spark is inherently altered in the process known as the Mending .

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group disbands; Radha returns to Keld, Teferi to Jamuraa, Jhoira seeks Jodah, and Venser makes his first planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Venser, now a planeswalker in his own right, makes his first planeswalk into the unknown.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new breed of Planeswalker first manifests in Venser of Urborg.
timeline.quote: The new breed manifested itself for the first time in Venser of Urborg

citation.text: "Planeswalker (lore)", section "Current Planeswalkers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koth encases Venser's head in stone to force him to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Koth flew into a rage and encased his head in a stone mask, coercing him to walk to Mirrodin.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Vengeance and Redemption". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koth, enraged by Venser's carelessness, encases his head in a stone mask to force him to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Koth flew into a rage and encased his head in a stone mask, coercing him to walk to Mirrodin.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Gathering Forces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Corrupted Harvester captures Venser and Koth, and Elspeth returns to help them escape.
timeline.quote: Venser and Koth fell quickly to a Corrupted Harvester and were dragged back to its lair near Ish Sah .

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Scarred". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Oxidda Chain Venser disables a leveler, and in Koth's village Koth's compleated mother attacks them and they destroy her.
timeline.quote: she has become compleated and attempts to kill them

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth has a panic attack after a fight with nim and a Phyrexian zombie and leaves.
timeline.quote: Elspeth has a panic attack and leaves

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser reveals to Koth that he is actually seeking Karn.
timeline.quote: Venser had revealed to Koth that he is actually seeking Karn

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser and Koth are captured in the Mephidross and brought to the Phyrexian lair at Ish Sah.
timeline.quote: taken capture and brought into their lair at Ish Sah

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koth escapes by melting his manacles and Elspeth kills the Phyrexians and frees Venser.
timeline.quote: Elspeth steps through, killing the Phyrexians and freeing Venser

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth confesses she was complicit with Phyrexians who tortured prisoners on her plane.
timeline.quote: she was complicit with the Phyrexians who tortured prisoners on her plane

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The trio reaches the Mirran resistance led by Ezuri.
timeline.quote: there encounter the Mirran resistance, led by the renegade elf, Ezuri

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret dispatches a crusher attacking the trio and leads them to the Surgical Bay.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret leads the others to the Surgical Bay

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser donates his spark and heart to Karn, who reignites and regains his memories and vows to stop the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: donating his spark to the golem, who instantly reignites and regains his memories and personality

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koth and Elspeth find Venser in his workshop and he shows them his planeshifting ship built from Phyrexian parts.
timeline.quote: Venser showed his incomplete ship to the pair

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koth recognizes the Phyrexian parts, threatens Venser, traps his head in a stone mask and forces him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: trapping his head in a stone mask and commanding him to planeswalk to Mirrodin

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group is ambushed by nim in the Mephidross, and Elspeth says she can go no further.
timeline.quote: the group was ambushed by nim

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser and Koth are captured by a Corrupted Harvester; Elspeth reappears and the trio escape and reach the Black Lacuna.
timeline.quote: Venser and Koth quickly fell to a Corrupted Harvester

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser teleports into the Black Lacuna, finds a shrine to Karn, is attacked by Geth, and sees the Phyrexian army invade the surface.
timeline.quote: At this shrine, he was assaulted by Geth and was forced to flee back to the surface

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The companions encounter Ezuri's rebels; Ezuri tries to stop them but backs down when Elspeth threatens him.
timeline.quote: When Elspeth threatened Ezuri, however, the elf backed down

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret captures Elspeth and Venser after Koth leaves with Melira.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret ordered a halt to the battle and captured the two Planeswalkers

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koth and Melira free the pair; Tezzeret's forces fight Glissa's, letting the companions reach Karn's throne room.
timeline.quote: his forces did battle with Glissa's, allowing the companions to escape

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Melira cleanses Karn's body but not his heart, and Venser gives his life and spark to Karn, freeing him from Phyrexian tyranny.
timeline.quote: With his last remaining mana, he gave his life and spark to Karn.

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koth, Elspeth and Venser try to track the Phyrexian corruption to its source, but it is far too late.
timeline.quote: And all three of them believed they could track the Phyrexian corruption to its source

citation.work: Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered
citation.text: "Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Mirrans realize the full breadth of the threat and unite under a single banner.
timeline.quote: The struggle has caused Mirrodin's heterogeneous population to fly a single banner.

citation.work: Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered
citation.text: "Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth breaks into Ish Sah and frees her companions.
timeline.quote: she made her way to where they were held and cut a swath of destruction to them

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The companions fight Phyrexian butchers and escape through a meat shaft.
timeline.quote: Elspeth slew many, but they were outnumbered

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser gives his life and spark to Karn, curing the golem.
timeline.quote: Venser gave his life and spark to Karn, curing the golem.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser gives his life and spark to Karn, who is released from Phyrexian tyranny.
timeline.quote: he gave his life and spark to Karn

citation.text: "Karn", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The companions meet the rebel leader Ezuri, who backs down when threatened.
timeline.quote: But when Elspeth threatened Ezuri, and Venser displayed a bit of his magic, the elf backed down and his followers fled.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser gives his life and spark to Karn, curing the golem.
timeline.quote: With his last strength, Venser gave his life and spark to Karn, curing the golem.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, Koth and Venser free Melira from Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Melira was freed by Elspeth Tirel , Koth , and Venser from Tezzeret 's clutches

citation.text: "Melira", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser gives his immunity to Karn, curing him at the cost of his life.
timeline.quote: Venser gave his immunity to Karn, curing the golem at the cost of his life.

citation.text: "Melira", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Resistance heals Karn through Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: through the sacrifice of Venser , healed him from the physical and mental damages

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Domination of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koth's spellbomb, modified with Venser's schematics, is placed beneath the new throne room.
timeline.quote: We'd modified it using Venser's schematics.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Koth encased Venser's head in rock and coerced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: He encased his head in rock and coerced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals that Venser gave up his spark to save Karn and died.
timeline.quote: Venser gave up his spark to Karn, to rescue him. Venser did not survive.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi greets Karn aboard the Weatherlight, and Jhoira says Ajani told her of Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Ajani Goldmane came to tell me. Teferi knows, too.
